check_box.label: Show own avatar in Nearby People radar
check_box.tool_tip: If checked, your own avatar will appear in the Nearby People radar list.
check_box.name: show_own_avatar_in_radar

check_box.label: Save final snapshot on exit
check_box.tool_tip: If checked, the viewer will save a snapshot on exit (original viewer behavior). Disabled by default.
check_box.name: save_final_snapshot

combo_box.tool_tip: Select Standard transparency, lossless Exact OIT, or faster approximate AVBOIT. The selection is applied live.
combo_box.name: render_oit_mode

panel.label: Preload
panel.name: tab-as-preload
panel.text: Preload Dullahan hosts (accelerates window loading at the cost of dozens of processes):

check_box.label: Destinations
check_box.tool_tip: If checked, the Dullahan (CEF) host for the Destinations floater will be preloaded at startup.
check_box.name: preload_dullahan_destinations

check_box.label: Avatar welcome pack
check_box.tool_tip: If checked, the Dullahan (CEF) host for the Avatar Welcome Pack floater will be preloaded at startup.
check_box.name: preload_dullahan_avatar_welcome_pack

check_box.label: Search
check_box.tool_tip: If checked, the Dullahan (CEF) host for the Search floater will be preloaded at startup. Only effective when the FS legacy search mode is active.
check_box.name: preload_dullahan_search

check_box.label: Legacy search
check_box.tool_tip: If checked, the Dullahan (CEF) host for the Legacy Search floater will be preloaded at startup. Only effective when the FS legacy search mode is not active.
check_box.name: preload_dullahan_legacy_search

check_box.label: Marketplace
check_box.tool_tip: If checked, the Dullahan (CEF) host for the Marketplace floater will be preloaded at startup.
check_box.name: preload_dullahan_marketplace

check_box.label: Ask before changing the audio stream
check_box.tool_tip: If checked, when you enter a parcel with a different audio stream or with no stream, the viewer asks whether to keep listening to the current stream. The stream keeps playing while you decide. Disabled by default.
check_box.name: as_keep_stream_ask

check_box.label: Play my default favorite stream instead of the parcel stream
check_box.tool_tip: If checked, entering a parcel plays your default favorite stream instead of the parcel's own stream. Set the default from the Favorite Streams floater. Disabled by default.
check_box.name: as_autoplay_default_favorite

check_box.label: Show the 'add stream to favorites' button in the status bar
check_box.tool_tip: If checked, a button next to the stream toggle adds the currently playing stream to your favorites.
check_box.name: as_show_add_favorite_stream_button

check_box.label: Show avatar thumbnails on conversation tabs
check_box.tool_tip: If checked, 1:1 avatar conversation tabs show a small profile picture thumbnail. Disabled by default.
check_box.name: as_show_conversation_tab_avatar_thumbnails

check_box.label: Show a yellow border on the thumbnail while the avatar is typing
check_box.tool_tip: If checked, the avatar thumbnail on a 1:1 conversation tab shows a yellow border while the other person is typing. Requires avatar thumbnails to be enabled. Disabled by default.
check_box.name: as_show_conversation_tab_typing_border

check_box.label: Show conversation tab name in italics when avatar is typing
check_box.tool_tip: If checked, a 1:1 conversation tab's label is shown in italics while the other person is typing. Disabled by default.
check_box.name: as_show_typing_tab_italics

check_box.label: Show an 'Avatars in range' tab in the Conversations window
check_box.tool_tip: If checked, a Radar tab listing nearby avatars is docked in the Conversations window. Disabled by default.
check_box.name: as_show_radar_in_conversations

check_box.label: Show a 'Recent people' tab in the Conversations window
check_box.tool_tip: If checked, a Recent people tab is docked in the Conversations window. Disabled by default.
check_box.name: as_show_recent_people_in_conversations
